name: Precision Sniper Rifle
summary: Long-range bolt-action sniper rifle confirmed in GTA VI trailers used by Jason on highway overpass. Delivers one-shot kills at extreme distance.
description: The Precision Sniper Rifle is a hybrid bolt-action platform combining the accuracy of the Remington 700 with the heavy-caliber stopping power of the Barrett M82. Seen in GTA VI trailer footage with Jason positioned on a highway overpass, the rifle features a high-magnification scope, suppressor-ready muzzle, and a 10-round detachable box magazine. At extreme distances it can penetrate light vehicle cover.

seo.description: Full profile of the Precision Sniper Rifle in GTA VI. Damage, range, attachments, and where to find this bolt-action long-range weapon in Leonida.
